recommendation.rationale: All observed eligible benchmarks allow and prefer noChange; forced noChange prevents every visible harmful edit, loses no demonstrated useful refinement, eliminates clear wrong-language outputs, and preserves protected-token safety. The strict surface envelope re-admits capitalization-only failures, while no positive orthographic repair exists to justify an exception.

tokenDefinition.summary: A primary one-token input is exactly one deterministic lexical/content unit after trimming. Whitespace separates units, but a single group is then shape-classified rather than accepted naively: Unicode lexical words may carry leading/trailing punctuation; URLs, emails, handles, identifiers, code-like forms, numbers, money, emoji sequences, and mixed alphanumeric identifiers are each one content unit. Punctuation-only and unresolved ambiguous-other groups are listed separately and excluded.
